html: קסם (√ of foll.; appar. orig. divide, assign (deity). Arabic قَسَمَ divide, distribute, x. get a part allotted to oneself, especially by drawing lots [with headless arrows] at a sanctuary (cf. especially Ez 21:26, 27); iv. أَقْسَمَ swear; v. also Ethiopic ቀሰመ: iv. use divination, so 𝔗 קְסַם, Syriac ܩܨܰܡ; קִיסְמָא divination; see especially RSJPhil. xiii (1885), 276 ff., WeSkizzen iii. 127 f.167; Heid. 2. 132ff. Dr Dt 18:10).
